workflows.workflowGoal: Build sufficient trust to use a classifier by understanding its learned rules and certainty and then verifying its predictions and failure conditions.
workflows.description: Domain experts inspect a global rule-based explanation, its support and confidence, then focus on selected data or custom inputs to verify individual predictions and locate likely failures.
workflows.applicabilityContext: For domain experts with little machine-learning expertise who need to assess a trained classifier before adoption or verify it after deployment.
targetUsers: Domain experts with little knowledge of machine learning

stages.localGoal: Understand what the classifier has learned and how strongly each rule is supported and approximates the model.
stages.activitySummary: Navigate and compare the aligned rules, use the data flow to read rule support and order, inspect rule fidelity, filter low-support or low-confidence rules when necessary, re-expand collapsed rule groups when needed, and request clause text or distribution details for closer comparison.

usedCoordinations.description: Support and confidence thresholds reduce and collapse the displayed rule list across the aligned main components.
Selecting a rule cell expands its distribution so clause intervals can be inspected and compared.

stages.expectedOutcome: A global understanding of the model's learned rules and the support and fidelity of those rules.

quotes: Before they can fully adopt a model, adequate trust about how the model generally behaves need to be established.

stages.localGoal: Inspect what rule-based knowledge the model uses to predict a selected instance or subset.
stages.activitySummary: Enter a customized input, request the original model's prediction and highlighted satisfied rule, and read the aligned rule clauses and output that explain the prediction.

usedCoordinations.description: A customized input is bound to its model prediction and highlighted satisfied rule.

stages.expectedOutcome: An explanation of the model's prediction in terms of the satisfied rule, its conditions, and its output.

quotes: What knowledge does the model utilize to make a prediction?
request the system to present the prediction of the original model and highlight the satisfied rule

stages.localGoal: Identify subsets and conditions under which the model is likely to fail.
stages.activitySummary: Filter feature ranges to focus on data of interest, inspect the updated rule evidence and prediction errors, and browse the supporting filtered records when needed.

usedCoordinations.description: Feature-range filtering updates the displayed explanation, error evidence, and supporting records.

stages.expectedOutcome: An evidence-based characterization of the subset or conditions where the classifier should not be fully trusted.

quotes: When and where is the model likely to fail?

transitions.rationale: After global understanding, the Q3 branch supports verifying why the model predicts a selected instance or subset.

quotes: this question is about verifying the model's prediction on a single instance or a subset of instances, instead of understanding the model in general

transitions.rationale: After global understanding, the Q4 branch supports identifying conditions where predictions should not be fully trusted.

quotes: we need to provide guidance on when and where the model is likely to fail

workflows.expectedFinalOutcome: A domain expert can understand the classifier's rule-based behavior and decide when its predictions are sufficiently supported or require caution.

paperLevelClaims.claimText: RuleMatrix is intended to help users with little machine-learning expertise understand, explore, and validate predictive models.

quotes: help users with little expertise in machine learning to understand, explore and validate predictive models
